'''Shakudo leggings''' are [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]] of the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] tier, made by smithing [[copper leggings]] with [[shakudo alloy]]. They clear Slowness.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the copper item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give 6 armor with 500 durability, the same armor as the matching diamond piece but with no toughness. The full shakudo set gives 20 armor.

=== Intrinsics ===
* '''[[Cleanse]]''': removes Slowness from the wearer whenever it is applied.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/cleanse_armor_legs.mcfunction}}</ref>
* '''Magic protection''': [[Magic protection]] adds 8 protection points against magic damage, such as Poison and Instant Damage.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/magic_protection.json}}</ref>
* '''Regeneration''': Every worn piece of shakudo armor counts towards the tier's regeneration: with one piece the wearer gets {{Data/Set bonus|shakudo_regen=1}}, and with two, three and four pieces the interval shortens to {{Data/Set bonus|shakudo_regen=2|show=every}}, {{Data/Set bonus|shakudo_regen=3|show=every}} and {{Data/Set bonus|shakudo_regen=4|show=every}} seconds. The [[Elytra#Shakudo Elytra|shakudo elytra]] counts as one piece. The pack defines an elytra bonus that would count five and grant Regeneration II, but the elytra does not carry it, so four worn pieces is the most that can be reached. The intrinsic also counts in the main hand, so holding a fifth shakudo piece raises the count to five: {{Data/Set bonus|shakudo_regen=5}} (see [[Set bonus#Shakudo regeneration]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/shakudo_armour.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/stopwatches.mcfunction}}</ref>

Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

They keep the copper armor item ID, so a [[blast furnace]] melts them into a single copper ingot, and they can be smithed again into hepatizon armor.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[shakudo alloy]], which lets the alloy be reused on a fresh copper item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_leggings.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Shakudo armor could not be crafted; this was fixed.}}
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive (2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper instead of 3 gold and 6 copper ingots). Added the regeneration intrinsic and its per-piece bonus. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12|Fixed severe multiplayer lag caused by shakudo armor.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Shakudo armor was nerfed, and its intrinsics became exclusive with the electrum and adamant ones.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
